scope: Sixteen table-supported development pilots, all score zero. Earlier pilots establish routing and transient topology or stop on geometry/guard failures. Trial 015 validates the fixed physics switch but ends on a policy exception. Trial 016 validates measured placement and normal stop handling, then stops on actual capsule contact during support-hand withdrawal. No full-score task is demonstrated.
numeric_precision: Measured values are rounded to 9 decimal places; artifact hashes identify the original full-precision data.
measurement_limits: Top-view crossings and tip position do not prove under/over passage or knot topology.
Arch height is measured at the held segment centre minus rope radius, not the minimum available passage clearance.
The near-table fraction counts sampled segment centres with surface height below 15 mm.
Motion extrema are from 20 Hz telemetry, not continuous-time certificates.
This summary records numeric checks only; it does not claim visual review or submission readiness.

table-015.outcome: The fixed 78-second 240→960 Hz transition passed native and independent replay checks, with unchanged state and 60 complete post-switch control intervals. Cord geometry remained valid. The policy errored at 81.00 seconds while reporting a 13.885 mm TCP tracking miss; a duplicate label argument concealed the intended stop. Recording finalized cleanly and CLI returned 0, but Inspect explicitly reports policy error. No support release, recovery, pull or final retention was completed; independent score is zero.
